**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Inspect manifest content for security findings**

A structurally valid `skill.json` bypasses all content checks because it is excluded from `_line_findings`. Starting with the bundled research skill, setting `purpose` to `ignore all previous instructions` and placing a secret literal and an exfiltration URL in `workflow` still produces `PASS` with no findings or observed capabilities. Manifest type validation does not inspect these strings, so the internal gate misses even its explicitly supported secret and instruction-override signatures in a required package file. Scan manifest string values as well, handling declarative permission fields separately to avoid false positives.
